text: 1.Program Introduction：The program focuses on developing the basic theories, knowledge and skills in international economics and trade, learning the present situation of developmentof economy and trade in moderm China and world, and being familiar with the intermational trade law and regulations which makes graduates be capable ofsolving practical international trade issues.The internationalized as well as combined with Chinese reality curriculum is adopted in this program and case study is often used in teaching. The basicknowledge of economics, managements and international trade is taught in this program, which makes the graduates strong in theoretical analysis and practice.2.Main Courses：Micro-Economics, Macro-Economics, Econometrics, Brief of World Economy, Intermational Trade, International Trade Practice, International Economics and Trade Geography, International Buiness Documentation, Buiness English Listening and Speaking, International Finance Statistics3.Career and Internship：Graduates can engage in the international trade department, industrial and commercial enterprises, economic management departments or economic scientificresearch company.
